keys.swarm.aura_frost_nova_desc: A blast of frost hits and freezes monsters around you; a frozen monster shatters for double damage when hit again. Bosses cannot be frozen.
keys.swarm.aura_frost_nova_up: A wider blast and longer freeze, more often.
keys.swarm.aura_frost_nova_ten: Winter's Heart: a blizzard follows you, freezing and shattering.
keys.swarm.aura_chain_lightning_desc: A bolt of lightning jumps from monster to monster.
keys.swarm.aura_chain_lightning_ten: Storm Crown: a crown over your head throws three chains each time it triggers.
